svg.title: One hidden bit defeats a naive coloring bound
svg.desc: The input vector has a valid complete bipartite dependency graph with two colors, but each pairwise comparison equals the same hidden bit. The comparison terms form a clique. For m comparisons the exact upper tail probability is one half, while the incorrectly applied coloring formula exp(-m/8) falls below it at m=6.
